top: ...and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor,
bottom: The mighty God, The everlasting Father, The Prince of Peace.

top: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water
bottom: out of the wells of salvation.

top: At that day shall a man look to his Maker,
bottom: and his eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

top: And the key of the house of David...
bottom: ...so he shall open, and none shall shut...

top: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace,
bottom: whose mind is stayed on thee...

top: In returning and rest shall ye be saved;
bottom: in quietness and in confidence shall be your strength...

top: Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone,
bottom: a tried stone, a precious corner stone...
